---
title: "`r params$title`"
subtitle: "`r params$subtitle`"
date: "`r params$date`"
params:
  title: "MarineSABRES SES Analysis Report"
  subtitle: ""
  date: ""
  body_file: ""
---

```{r report-body, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Static report shell (review 2026-10-07 N11). The body generated by
# generate_report_content() is user-influenced Markdown (project name, focal
# issue, element and stakeholder names...). It is never written into an Rmd
# and knitted: this template is the only Rmd, it contains no user text, and
# the body is emitted here as a plain string with results='asis', so knitr
# never evaluates anything inside it. functions/report_render.R renders with
# md_extensions = "-raw_html" and escapes YAML delimiter lines in the body, so
# raw HTML and in-body metadata blocks are shown as text, not interpreted.
cat(readLines(params$body_file, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"), sep = "\n")
```
